local W, H = 1452, 793
local th = math.tan(math.rad(35))
local o = Vector3.new(12,6,-12)
local cf = CFrame.lookAt(o, Vector3.new(40,5,-40))
local out = {}
for _, p in ipairs({ {415,555},{1035,555},{410,575},{300,400} }) do
	local nx = (p[1] - W / 2) / (H / 2) * th
	local ny = -(p[2] - H / 2) / (H / 2) * th
	local dir = (cf.LookVector + cf.RightVector * nx + cf.UpVector * ny).Unit
	local r = workspace:Raycast(o, dir * 600)
	if r then local i = r.Instance
		table.insert(out, string.format("%d,%d %s [%s] %s %d,%d,%d at (%.1f,%.1f,%.1f) n(%.2f,%.2f,%.2f)", p[1], p[2], i:GetFullName(), i.ClassName, i.Material.Name, i.Color.R*255+0.5, i.Color.G*255+0.5, i.Color.B*255+0.5, r.Position.X, r.Position.Y, r.Position.Z, r.Normal.X, r.Normal.Y, r.Normal.Z))
	else table.insert(out, p[1] .. "," .. p[2] .. " sky") end
end
return table.concat(out, string.char(10))
